caption: Two women embrace emotionally amid a cheering crowd celebrating election results in Belgrade.

Urda, Spain Cranes lift wrecked train carriages as rescuers search for victims after a crash between two trains. Spain began three days of mourning on Thursday for at least 69 people who died in the crash, as dozens of injured passengers remained in hospital. Train drivers went on strike to urge more investment in railway safety.

Kyiv, Ukraine Rescuers clear fallen trees near a destroyed car on a road in Kyiv after a Russian missile strike. Russian strikes damaged a university campus and Kyiv’s important Southern Bridge on Tuesday night, in what Volodymyr Zelenskyy described as ‘a serious escalation’ against ​Ukrainian infrastructure.

Kharkiv, Ukraine A firefighter at the site of a Russian strike in a residential area of Kharkiv amid the ongoing Russian invasion. Finland’s president, Alexander Stubb, and Norway’s prime minister, Jonas Gahr Støre, held what they described as a ‘frank and substantive’ phone call with Vladimir Putin this week about efforts to end the war.

Belgrade, Serbia Supporters of the Student List celebrate after Aleksandar Vučić, the long-serving leader of Serbia, conceded defeat in the election. The concession ushered in a seismic political shift after a historic election that saw ​the increasingly authoritarian leader pitted against a student-led movement that had spent two years protesting against his government.

Orléans, France A security guard removes a protester from a launch rally for Marine Le Pen’s presidential campaign during the Rassemblement National party convention. Le Pen, who has lodged an appeal to France’s highest court over her conviction for embezzlement of European parliament funds , promised to ‘bring back order to France’.

Brasília, Brazil A supporter of the rightwing Liberal party presidential candidate, Flávio Bolsonaro, reacts while watching the results during the vote count. The astonishing comeback victory of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva brought rapturous supporters on to the streets , while also thrilling conservationists, climate activists and social justice campaigners across the world.

Miami, Florida, US The Brazilian presidential candidate Flàvio Bolsonaro arrives at Miami-Opa Locka airport with his family. Bolsonaro declared himself the ‘true president’ of Brazil after losing the presidential election and fleeing to the US, even though his own party has recognised the legitimate victory of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva , as have all of Brazil’s institutions and international observers who monitored the vote.

Detroit, Michigan, US Supporters of the Democratic Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed applaud during a speech by the former president Barack Obama, during a campaign rally at Cass technical high school in Detroit. Obama said El-Sayed was ‘fighting for change, real change, that will get money out of politics and put money in your pocket’ , as he threw his weight behind the Democratic candidate.

Maracay, Venezuela The Venezuelan opposition leader, María Corina Machado, greets supporters on her return to the country after nearly a year abroad. The Trump administration had reportedly opposed Machado’s return, believing her presence would complicate the cosy relationship it has struck up with the interim president, Delcy Rodríguez, since abducting the former leader Nicolás Maduro in January.

Hebron, West Bank An Israeli border police officer casts his ballot at a polling station in the occupied West Bank city of Hebron during Israel’s legislative election. Netanyahu’s far-right coalition lost its majority in the election after four years in power. The main Jewish opposition bloc also fell short, however, leaving two Arab Israeli parties, the Joint List and Ra’am, holding the balance of power.

Jerusalem An Arab woman walks with a child in Jerusalem past a torn Likud party campaign ad featuring Benjamin Netanyahu and Donald Trump, with a Hebrew message reading ‘We have one opportunity to win’. Netanyahu has been accused of using smear tactics to cling to power, after he claimed Arab Israeli parties had used foreign backing to ‘steal’ Tuesday’s election.

Gaza Children react as people take cover from a reported drone strike while queueing at a charity kitchen in the Jabaliya camp. Most people in Gaza were too preoccupied by the struggle to find food and water to follow the Israeli election campaign . Fears of renewed hunger are mounting as markets run short of fresh produce and other essentials.

Alalak, Indonesia Pupils were sent home early from this primary school as thick smoke from a land fire behind it engulfed the area. Almost 2m hectares have gone up in smoke in Indonesia’s worst fire season in a decade , enveloping the region in a thick dystopian haze.

Tirana, Albania People wave a flag as demonstrators gather at Skanderbeg Square during an anti-government protest by students in Tirana. Albania has introduced fines of more than $6,000 for demonstrators who participate in a protest that turns violent, even if they don’t personally commit violent acts, as the government tries to clamp down on the rallies calling for the prime minister’s resignation.

Paris, France Gendarmes walk through teargas during clashes with protesters at an authorised demonstration organised by labour unions in Paris. Hundreds of thousands marched in cities across France last Saturday in largely peaceful protests to support schoolchildren’s demands for more teachers and repairs to dilapidated buildings, as Emmanuel Macron faces a social and political crisis in his final months as president.

Paris, France Police in riot gear face protesters during a demonstration in favour of protecting public services, and fiscal and social justice. Emmanuel Macron has been accused by trade unions of trying to curb the fundamental French right to protest as the government fast-tracks a bill to make protesters pay for damage caused by vandalism , even if they did not directly cause it themselves.
Hardelot, France Migrants stand in shallow water after a failed attempt to board a small boat to cross the Channel to England.

Huntington Beach, California, US James Hays paddles with his dog Flynn in high-tide flooding along the Pacific Coast Highway. Historic high tides have caused chaos up and down the California coast this week.

Fleetwood, England Fleetwood Town players celebrate winning a penalty shootout against Arsenal in the Carabao Cup fourth round. Fleetwood’s manager, Matt Lawlor, hailed the club’s victory as one for all football after his side shocked the Premier League champions on penalties. The side, currently 18th in League Two, held their nerve in the shootout, with Conor Haughey hitting the winner to reach the quarter-finals.
Dancers in headdresses.
Kafr Malik, West Bank Settlers gather next to members of the Israeli forces as Palestinians are prevented from continuing their olive harvest.
Hardelot, France People left behind after a failed attempt to board a small boat crossing the Channel.
Doha, Qatar A display of Arabian oryx at an exhibition on the role of art in literature at the National Museum.
Wollongong, Australia A fan celebrates the second try of Freedom Crichton Ropati of Samoa during a Women’s Rugby League World Cup group match against England.
Tecoluca, El Salvador Inmates at the Terrorism Confinement Center maximum-security prison before a visit by Peru’s president, Keiko Fujimori.
London, UK A deer walks in the morning mist during rutting season on a foggy autumn morning in Bushy Park in the south-west of the city.
Kangwon, North Korea An image released by the state news agency of 600mm multiple rocket launchers being fired during an exhibition of aeronautical technology.
Gaza City, Gaza Buildings and tents sheltering displaced Palestinians sustain heavy damage after an Israeli army strike in the al-Saftawi area of the city.
Kromlau, Germany The Rakotzbrücke, a 19th-century bridge built of basalt stones to create a perfect circle with its reflection, at the Azalea and Rhododendron Park.
La Restinga, Spain People wait to be assisted by the Red Cross after disembarking from a coast guard vessel at the port of La Restinga on El Hierro in the Canary Islands.
San Angelo, US A campaign advertisement for the Democratic Senate candidate James Talarico and gubernatorial candidate Gina Hinojosa in San Angelo in west Texas.
St Petersburg, Russia Cadets walk past memorials mounted on trees during a ceremony to honour the victims of Soviet-era political repression.
Mexico City, Mexico A 32-metre Catrina sculpture in the Zócalo square during the Day of the Dead celebration. It has earned a Guinness world record as the tallest Catrina.
Tirana, Albania Opposition politicians light flares in parliament as they seek to disrupt a vote, accusing the prime minister of downplaying continuing anti-government protests.
Santa Susanna, Spain The 90-year-old bodybuilder Toshisuke Kanazawa of Japan poses with his participation medal at the IFBB World Championships in Catalonia.
Rome, Italy A demonstrator waves an Italian flag during a general strike called by the USB Piemonte union. Workers and students are protesting against war, the economy and the rising cost of living.
Sloviansk, Ukraine A man repairs his windows after a Russian airstrike on a residential building.
Georgetown, Guyana Dancers take part in a Guyanese cultural performance during a state reception held in honour of Britain’s King Charles III.
Mount Semeru emits smoke beneath grey clouds, with Lumajang fields and trees in the foreground.
Huntington Beach, California, US A man surfs through floodwaters.
Chillicothe, Ohio, US Donald Trump departs after speaking at a campaign rally held at Ohio University Chillicothe.
Tirana, Albania Opposition lawmakers light flares and set off smoke bombs during a parliament session.
Najaf, Iraq People walk past a roadside stall during a dust storm.
Sydney, Australia Tourists climb the Sydney Harbour Bridge behind the Opera House on a spring day.
Lumajang, Indonesia Children are taken to school on a motorcycle across a stream of cold lava flow from Semeru.
London, UK Humboldt penguins swim during a photocall to promote Halloween at London Zoo.
Shangrao, China Farmers steer boats between rows of cages to manage eels at an aquaculture farm in the north-east of Jiangxi province.
St Petersburg, Florida, US The Milwaukee Brewers celebrate after winning baseball’s World Series against the Tampa Bay Rays.
Morrow, Georgia, US The former US president Barack Obama attends a rally before the midterm elections.
New York City, US A protester is detained by NYPD officers for blocking the Brooklyn Bridge in a demonstration for Oscar Belgal, a man shot by ICE.
Gaza Palestinians look at the wreckage of a vehicle destroyed by an Israeli airstrike at the Maghazi refugee camp.
Madrid, Spain Employees of the Iryo high-speed rail company at Atocha railway station after observing a minute’s silence for the victims of the train collision in Urda.
Urda, Spain Cranes lift wrecked train carriages as rescuers search for victims after a collision between two trains in Toledo province.
Seville, Spain Santa Justa train station is quiet after a five-minute silence for the victims of the collision of the two high-speed trains.
